securityReview.cause: Whole-document body/frameset attribute hydration during js_new_ex settle preceded the eager-frame head-meta/script parser walk.
securityReview.fix: Defer only eager-frame parsed handler hydration; activate at each body/frameset parser position after prior head meta/scripts.
securityReview.retained: Native element-owner realm and CSP compilation, sandbox policy, blocked-update preservation, cached earlier handlers and listener positions. No dispatch-time blanket CSP recheck.
